desc: The 7.92×57mm Mauser ( designated as the 8mm Mauser or 8×57mm by the SAAMI) cartridge was adopted by the German Empire in 1903–1905, and was the German service cartridge in both World Wars. In the first half of the 20th century, the 7.92×57mm Mauser cartridge was one of the world's most popular military cartridges. In the 21st century, it is a popular civilian sport and hunting cartridge in the West
